import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from tools.request_doctor import audit
import tools.request_doctor

assert Path(tools.request_doctor.__file__).resolve().parent.parent == Path(os.environ['DA_EXPECTED_TOOLS']).resolve()
inputs = json.loads(Path('out/corpus/j081/request-inputs.json').read_text())
reports = {}
for case in inputs:
    path = Path(case['database'])
    before = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    reports[case['case']] = audit(path)
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == before == case['database_sha256']
Path(os.environ['DA_REQUEST_PROFILE_OUTPUT']).write_text(json.dumps(reports, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'snapshots':len(reports),'unchanged_inputs':True}))

import hashlib
import json
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

root=Path('out/corpus/j081')
output=root/'request-inputs'
output.mkdir()
inputs=json.loads(Path('out/corpus/j080/inputs.json').read_text())
source=Path(next(row['database'] for row in inputs if row['case']=='revision-1'))
raw=source.read_bytes()
deep={'leaf':True}
for _ in range(60):
    deep={'child':deep}
cases=[
 ('invalid-root', 'UPDATE analysis_memo SET record_json=?', ('{',)),
 ('invalid-bill', "UPDATE publications SET delivery_json=json_set(delivery_json, '$.bill_json', ?)", ('{',)),
 ('invalid-change', "UPDATE publications SET delivery_json=json_set(delivery_json, '$.change_json', ?)", ('{',)),
 ('empty-bill', "UPDATE publications SET delivery_json=json_set(delivery_json, '$.bill_json', ?)", ('',)),
 ('scalar-bill', "UPDATE publications SET delivery_json=json_set(delivery_json, '$.bill_json', ?)", ('7',)),
 ('list-bill', "UPDATE publications SET delivery_json=json_set(delivery_json, '$.bill_json', ?)", ('[]',)),
 ('nested-bill', "UPDATE publications SET delivery_json=json_set(delivery_json, '$.bill_json', ?)", (json.dumps({'change_json':json.dumps({'wrapper':{'request_sha256':'a'*64}})}),)),
 ('depth', 'UPDATE publications SET delivery_json=?', (json.dumps(deep),)),
 ('root-list', 'UPDATE analysis_memo SET record_json=?', (json.dumps([{'request_sha256':'a'*64}]),)),
 ('absent-sha', "UPDATE bills SET analysis_json=json_remove(analysis_json, '$.request_sha256')", ()),
 ('null-sha', "UPDATE bills SET analysis_json=json_set(analysis_json, '$.request_sha256', NULL)", ()),
 ('invalid-sha', "UPDATE bills SET analysis_json=json_set(analysis_json, '$.request_sha256', 'broken')", ()),
 ('scalar-root', 'UPDATE analysis_memo SET record_json=?', ('42',)),
 ('object-bill', "UPDATE publications SET delivery_json=json_set(delivery_json, '$.bill_json', json(?))", (json.dumps({'nested':{'request_sha256':'a'*64}}),)),
 ('unicode', 'UPDATE analysis_memo SET record_json=?', (json.dumps({'żółć':{'request_sha256':'a'*64}},ensure_ascii=False),)),
 ('json-null', 'UPDATE analysis_memo SET record_json=?', ('null',)),
]
for name,query,parameters in cases:
    path=output/(name+'.db')
    with path.open('xb') as handle:
        handle.write(raw)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as database,database:
        database.execute(query,parameters)
    inputs.append({'case':'negative-'+name,'database':str(path.resolve()),'database_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_sql_sha256':None})
assert len(inputs)==29
(root/'request-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(inputs,indent=2)+'\n')
script=Path('out/corpus/j080/request_profile.py').read_text().replace('out/corpus/j080/inputs.json','out/corpus/j081/request-inputs.json')
(root/'request_profile.py').write_text(script)
print('Prepared 13 original and 16 negative/legacy/depth inputs.')

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from lexinform.adapters.sqlite_repo import SqliteBillRepository
from tools.computation_doctor import audit

root=Path.cwd()
output=root/'out/corpus/j081/graph-inputs'
output.mkdir()
profiles=[]
for group in ('normal','reuse','handoff','explanation','primary'):
    directory=output/group
    directory.mkdir()
    for source in sorted((root/'out/corpus/j078'/f'{group}-current').glob('*.sql')):
        raw=source.read_bytes()
        database=directory/(source.stem+'.db')
        repository=SqliteBillRepository(database)
        repository.migrate()
        repository.restore(raw.decode())
        assert repository.dump().encode()==raw
        repository.close()
        before=hashlib.sha256(database.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        report=audit(database)
        assert report['summary']['errors']==0,(group,source.stem,report['findings'])
        assert report['status']=='recorded',(group,source.stem,report['summary'])
        assert hashlib.sha256(database.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
        profiles.append({'case':f'{group}/{source.stem}','sql_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'database_sha256':before,'database_unchanged':True,'roundtrip_equal':True,'report':report})
assert len(profiles)==104
(root/'out/corpus/j081/graph-profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps(profiles,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'profiles':len(profiles),'all_recorded':True,'zero_errors':True,'all_inputs_unchanged':True}))

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from lexinform.models import BillStatus, TextDocument
from tests.fakes import FakeTextExtractor
from tests.harness import World
from tests.scenario.test_request_doctor import snapshot
from tools.computation_doctor import audit


def test_profile():
    output=Path('out/corpus/j081/reanalysis-inputs')
    output.mkdir()
    reports=[]
    for model in ('gpt-5.1','claude-opus-5-5'):
        for workers in (1,4):
            for persist in (False,True):
                old='Art. 1. Cudzoziemiec posiadający zezwolenie na pobyt otrzymuje 200 zł. '*40
                new=old.replace('200 zł','300 zł')
                world=World(profile='production',workers=workers,analysis_model=model,extractor=FakeTextExtractor(by_content={b'%PDF':old,b'%PDF-new':new}))
                world.add_bill('3039','Projekt ustawy o cudzoziemcach')
                world.run(track=False)
                world.batch.resolve()
                world.run(track=False)
                world.gateway.files['https://api.test/reanalysis-graph.pdf']=b'%PDF-new'
                document=TextDocument(url='https://api.test/reanalysis-graph.pdf',kind='print')
                world.analysis.start_run()
                assert world.analysis.reanalyze_bill(world.bill('3039'),document) is None
                world.analysis.submit_queued_batches()
                world.repo.reset_bill(10,'3039',BillStatus.ANALYZED)
                world.batch.resolve()
                world.analysis.collect_batches()
                world.analysis.acknowledge_batch_costs()
                assert world.repo.list_result_applications(10,'3039')[-1].outcome=='superseded'
                world.clock.advance(days=200)
                world.repo.prune_history(before=world.clock.now(),memo_before=world.clock.now())
                world.repo.restore(world.repo.dump())
                world.analysis.start_run()
                if persist:
                    record=world.analysis.reanalyze_bill(world.bill('3039'),document)
                else:
                    fresh,changed=world.analysis.prepare_reanalysis(world.bill('3039'),document)
                    assert changed
                    record=fresh.analysis
                assert record is not None and record.input_tokens==record.output_tokens==0
                assert len(world.batch.submitted)==2 and not world.repo.list_queued_batch_intents()
                case=f'{model}-{workers}-{persist}'
                directory=output/case
                directory.mkdir()
                path=snapshot(world,directory)
                before=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                report=audit(path)
                assert report['status']=='recorded' and report['summary']['errors']==0,report['findings']
                assert report['summary']['purpose_reanalysis']==1
                assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
                reports.append({'case':case,'database_sha256':before,'database_unchanged':True,'report':report})
    assert len(reports)==8
    Path('out/corpus/j081/reanalysis-profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2)+'\n')
